description.fallback: In the street lays the injured Alessi, who, after escaping from child Polnareff, has now come face to face with Jotaro. Jotaro states that he finds Alessi's jump through the window to be rather unusual, and wonders if he is the cause for his missing friend. Alessi plays dumb, stating that he merely tripped out of the window while cleaning it.
